plugins.name: prompt-prefix
plugins.description: Put a phrase of your choosing at the start of every prompt you send.

plugins.name: breadcrumbs
plugins.description: Pin notes to file paths so Claude sees them the moment it touches those files, and seal time-capsule notes that open on a future date.

plugins.name: scope-fence
plugins.description: Fence Claude's edits to the paths a task is about, and cap how many files it may change per session.

plugins.name: session-receipt
plugins.description: Print an itemised, till-style receipt of a session: time spent, prompts, every tool call, files read and changed.
